2560.name: Fiend Plate
desc:
An image captured while engaged in
surveillance of the Beastman
Confederate has been superimposed
onto this glass plate.

2561.name: Pizza Dough
desc: Excellent dough for making pizzas.

2562.name: 108-Knot Quipu
desc:
A knotted rope used by the Yagudo to
deliver orders. Due to the complexity and number of these knots, the encoded information is indecipherable.

2563.name: Karugo Clay
desc: An extremely high-quality, fine-grained clay originating in the vicinity of Fort Karugo-Narugo.

2564.name: Peiste Pellets
desc: A container of questionably produced feed pellets. The label simply reads, "Peiste." A pungent, fish-like odor emanates from within.

2565.name: Gnole Pellets
desc: A container of questionably produced feed pellets. The label simply reads, "Gnole." The familiar scent of blood emanates from within.

2566.name: Gnat Pellets
desc: A container of questionably produced feed pellets. The label simply reads, "Gnat." The putrid stench of rot and decay emanates from within.

2567.name: Dorter Key
desc: A key to the former living quarters of low-ranking Yagudo initiates, converted to a prison after the outbreak of war.

2568.name: Lthe. Consomme
desc:
A light and refreshing vegetable soup
that draws on the harmonizing effects
of eastern ginger for its aroma and
flavor. Standard chocobo fodder.

2569.name: Lethe Potage
desc:
A thick and hearty vegetable soup that
draws on the harmonizing effects of
eastern ginger for its aroma and flavor.
Standard chocobo fodder.

2570.name: Pelt of Dawon
desc: The pelt of the legendary tigress Dawon, soft to the touch and beautifully patterned in fiery orange and black.

2571.name: Balrahn's Eyepatch
desc:
An eyepatch worn by the celebrated
hero of legend, Balrahn. It is regarded
as a sacred relic throughout the empire
of Aht Urhgan.

2572.name: Pandemonium Key
desc:
An elaborately fashioned and ornate
key used to gain passage through the
Pandemonium Gate.

2573.name: Monkey Wine
desc:
A known favorite of the notorious
hydra, Tinnin. Allegedly irresistible
enough to draw the three-headed
beast out of hiding.

2574.name: Ferrite
desc:
A known favorite of the notorious
Armed Gears. Allegedly irresistible
enough to draw the robotic monstrosity
out of hiding.

2575.name: Sheep Botfly
desc:
A known favorite of the notorious
Mamool Ja, Gotoh Zha the Redolent.
Allegedly irresistible enough to draw
the fiend out of hiding.

2576.name: Olzhiryan Cactus
desc:
A known favorite of the notorious
wivre, Dea. Allegedly irresistible enough
to draw the hulking beast out of hiding.

2577.name: Senorita Pamama
desc:
A known favorite of the notorious
marid, Iriz Ima. Allegedly irresistible
enough to draw the pugnacious
pachyderm out of hiding.

2578.name: Oily Blood
desc:
A known favorite of the notorious
Lividroot Amooshah. Allegedly
irresistible enough to draw the dreaded
malboro matron out of hiding.

2579.name: Samariri Corpsehair
desc:
A known favorite of the notorious
Poroggo, Iriri Samariri. Allegedly
irresistible enough to draw the
nefarious amphibian out of hiding.

2580.name: Hellcage Butterfly
desc:
A known favorite of the notorious puk,
Vulpangue. Allegedly irresistible enough
to draw the plague-ridden pest out of
hiding.

2581.name: Floral Nectar
desc:
A known favorite of the notorious
colibri, Chamrosh. Allegedly irresistible
enough to draw the winged menace out
of hiding.

2582.name: Rodent Cheese
desc:
A known favorite of the notorious
Qiqirn, Cheese Hoarder Gigiroon.
Allegedly irresistible enough to draw
the cheesy hedonist out of hiding.

2583.name: Buffalo Corpse
desc:
A known favorite of the notorious
cerberus, Sarameya. Allegedly
irresistible enough to draw the
cantankerous canine out of hiding.

2584.name: Pure Blood
desc:
A known favorite of the notorious
vampyr, Nosferatu. Allegedly irresistible
enough to draw the perpetually
bloodlusting undead out of hiding.

2585.name: Vinegar Pie
desc:
A known favorite of the notorious
Troll, Khromasoul Bhurborlor. Allegedly
irresistible enough to draw the gigantic
oaf out of hiding.

2586.name: Rock Juice
desc:
A known favorite of the notorious
wamoura, Achamoth. Allegedly
irresistible enough to draw the
maneating moth out of hiding.

2587.name: Raw Buffalo
desc:
A known favorite of the notorious
dragon, Anantaboga. Allegedly
irresistible enough to draw the
ferocious reptilian out of hiding.

2588.name: Bone Charcoal
desc:
A known favorite of the notorious
bomb, Reacton. Allegedly irresistible
enough to draw the enraged explosive
out of hiding.

2589.name: Granulated Sugar
desc:
A known favorite of the notorious flan,
Dextrose. Allegedly irresistible enough
to draw the gelatinous blob out of
hiding.

2590.name: Shadeleaf
desc:
A known favorite of the notorious
wamoura larva, Brass Borer. Allegedly
irresistible enough to draw the
terrifying termite out of hiding.

2591.name: Pectin
desc:
A known favorite of the notorious
slime, Claret. Allegedly irresistible
enough to draw the blubbery mass out
of hiding.

2592.name: Cog Lubricant
desc:
A known favorite of the notorious
automaton, Ob. Allegedly irresistible
enough to draw the mechanical terror
out of hiding.

2593.name: Singed Buffalo
desc:
A known favorite of the notorious
khimaira, Tyger. Allegedly irresistible
enough to draw the mythic monster out
of hiding.

2594.name: Exorcism Treatise
desc:
A known favorite of the notorious
soulflayer, Mahjlaef the Paintorn.
Allegedly irresistible enough to draw
the merciless warlock out of hiding.

2595.name: Myrrh
desc:
A known favorite of the notorious
Experimental Lamia. Allegedly
irresistible enough to draw the
serpentine witch out of hiding.

2596.name: Rose Scampi
desc:
A known favorite of the notorious
orobon, Nuhn. Allegedly irresistible
enough to draw the foul fish out of
hiding.

2597.name: Opalus Gem
desc:
A known favorite of the notorious
acrolith, Wulgaru. Allegedly irresistible
enough to draw the arcane atrocity out
of hiding.

2598.name: M. No. 11 Molting
desc:
A known favorite of the notorious
qutrub, Zareehkl the Jubilant. Allegedly
irresistible enough to draw the
grotesque horror out of hiding.

2599.name: Mint Drop
desc:
A known favorite of the notorious imp,
Verdelet. Allegedly irresistible enough
to draw the evil sorcerer out of hiding.

2600.name: Golden Teeth
desc:
A known favorite of the notorious
skeleton, Velionis. Allegedly irresistible
enough to draw the bony ghoul out of
hiding.

2601.name: Greenling
desc:
A known favorite of the notorious Lil'
Apkallu. Allegedly irresistible enough to
draw the murderous avian out of hiding.

2602.name: Spoilt Blood
desc:
A known favorite of the notorious
chigoe, Chigre. Allegedly irresistible
enough to draw the bounding
bloodsucker out of hiding.

2603.name: Coin of Birth
desc: This aged bronze coin bears a peculiar glyph on one side, and the image of a sprouting seedling on the other.

2604.name: Coin of Adv.
desc: This aged bronze coin bears a peculiar glyph on one side, and the image of a rising sun on the other.

2605.name: Coin of Glory
desc: This aged bronze coin bears a peculiar glyph on one side, and the image of a rose in full bloom on the other.

2606.name: Coin of Decay
desc: This aged bronze coin bears a peculiar glyph on one side, and the image of a withered leaf on the other.

2607.name: Coin of Ruin
desc: This aged bronze coin bears a peculiar glyph on one side, and the image of a skull on the other.

2608.name: Plat. Chestnut
desc: An aromatic chestnut with a deep brown husk that grows in abundance on the lush grasslands of the La Theine Plateau. Rich in nutrients and quite tasty when roasted.

2609.name: Tinnin's Fang
desc:
The lethally toxic fang of the hydra,
Tinnin. It continues to drip poison from
the venom ducts within.

2610.name: A. Gears' Fragment
desc:
A mechanical fragment taken from the
disassembled remains of the menacing
Armed Gears. It appears to be a
generator designed for providing large
quantities of power.

2611.name: G. Zha's Necklace
desc:
Neckware of the Mamool Ja, Gotoh Zha
the Redolent. Forever imbued with the
indelible scent of its owner, it can be
equipped by none other.

2612.name: Dea's Horn
desc:
Taken from the nasal protrusion of
the massive wivre Dea, this imposing
horn is perfectly adapted for impaling
unwary targets.

2613.name: Iriz Ima's Hide
desc:
The thick, tough hide of Iriz Ima.
Its durability is a testament to its
capacity to protect the marid against
most forms of predation.

2614.name: Amoosh.'s Tendril
desc:
A wreathing, vinelike tendril amputated
from the malboro Lividroot Amooshah.
The meandering of the vine makes it
seem to continue to move, even in
death.

2615.name: Iriri Samariri's Hat
desc:
The perfectly form-fit hat of Poroggo 
Iriri Samariri. Tailor-made to an
amphibious head, it cannot and will not
adorn the typical adventurer noggin.

2616.name: Vulpangue's Wing
desc:
A wing clipping taken from the puk,
Vulpangue. Its lightness and thinness
belie both its strength and durability.

2617.name: Chamrosh's Beak
desc:
The razor-sharp beak of the colibri
Chamrosh, capable of easily tearing
apart the flesh of most any creature.

2618.name: Gigiroon's Cape
desc:
The cape and cowl of Qiqirn, Cheese
Hoarder Gigiroon. Fit to the unique
form of a Qiqirn body, it cannot be
donned by people, and reeks of
cheese.

2619.name: Sarameya's Hide
desc:
The tough, near-impenetrable hide of
Sarameya, one of the few known extant
members of the cerberus family.

2620.name: Nosferatu's Claw
desc:
Plunged into its victims and then
licked clean of the dripping blood,
this clawed appendage of the vampyr
Nosferatu still possesses a tangible
eeriness.

2621.name: Bblr.'s Vambrace
desc:
The solid and well-worn plate
armguard once donned by the Troll,
Khromasoul Bhurborlor. As with all troll
armor, it is far too cumbersome to be
worn by even the strongest of people.

2622.name: Acham.'s Antenna
desc:
An antenna taken from the fallen
wamoura, Achamoth. This tentacular
appendage is adept at detecting even
invisible and silent prey.

2623.name: Anantaboga's Heart
desc:
The enormous heart of the dragon,
Anantaboga. It is still saturated
through and through with foul reptilian
blood.

2624.name: Reacton's Ashes
desc:
The smoldering remains of the bomb,
Reacton. Despite the passage of time,
the cinders retain their immense heat.

2625.name: Dextrose's Blubber
desc:
The blubberous flesh of the flan,
Dextrose. It jiggles incessantly, even
when at rest.

2626.name: B. Borer's Cocoon
desc:
A cutting taken from the elaborate
cocoon spun by the larval wamoura,
Brass Borer.

2627.name: Claret Globule
desc:
A tiny blob of gelatinous flesh hacked
from the body of the slime, Claret.

2628.name: Ob's Arm
desc:
A technologically advanced automaton
arm, salvaged from the dismantled
remains of Ob.

2629.name: Tyger's Tail
desc:
Cleaved from the ferocious khimaira,
Tyger, this once lethal tail is wielded
in both whipping and stabbing motions.

2630.name: Mahjlaef's Staff
desc:
Too great in power and size to be
wielded by people, this wicked staff of
the soulflayer Mahjlaef the Paintorn is
no doubt responsible for the deaths of
countless adventurers.

2631.name: Ex. Lamia Armband
desc:
Decorative and protective armware of
Experimental Lamia. It inexplicably
resists being equipped on the arm of
any other.

2632.name: Nuhn's Esca
desc:
The bioluminescent, bulbous sac of
the oboron, Nuhn. The light is used to
attract unsuspecting prey in the dark
depths of cold waters.

2633.name: Wulgaru's Head
desc:
The severed head of the acrolith,
Wulgaru. It was once animated by a
most malicious arcane presence.

2634.name: Zrkl.'s Neckpiece
desc:
Necklace formerly worn by the qutrub,
Zareehkl the Jubilant. It is not
suited to dress the neck of any other individual.

2635.name: Verdelet's Wing
desc:
The detached, fleshy wing of the imp,
Verdelet. Either by some latent magic,
or simply remaining nerves, it twitches
periodically.

2636.name: Velionis's Bone
desc:
A shard of blackened bone taken from
the remains of the wicked skeleton,
Velionis.

2637.name: Lil' Apkallu's Egg
desc:
A shiny egg laid by Lil' Apkallu. The
pale green hue of the eggshell is an
unmistakable sign.

2638.name: Chigre
desc:
The complete and well-preserved
corpse of arguably the rarest member
of the chigoe family, Chigre.

2639.name: Hardened Bone
desc: This bone of indeterminate origin is hard enough to pass for solid rock. It would be highly difficult to craft.

2640.name: Murex Spicule
desc: A peculiar spiny protrusion removed from the curious creature known as a murex.

2641.name: Amb. Pseudopod
desc: A mass of some unidentifiable organic substance removed from the curious creature known as an amoeban.

2642.name: Kabenro
desc:
A ninjutsu tool
used in casting "Myoshu."

2643.name: Jinko
desc:
A ninjutsu tool
used in casting "Yurin."

2644.name: Ryuno
desc:
A ninjutsu tool
used in casting "Kakka."

2645.name: Eastern Ginger
desc:
An eastern variety of ginger valued for
its sharp, refreshing aroma. Believed in
the East to possess divine powers of
protection, lending to its common
usage as a design motif in many coats
of arms.

2646.name: Meta. Balsam
desc:
A fragrant oil rumored to possess
aromas so potent they can alter the
very personalities of those who smell
them.

2647.name: Meta. Perfume
desc:
A fragrant perfume rumored to possess
aromas so potent they can alter the
very personalities of those who smell
them.

2648.name: Ant. Arrowhd.
desc: The striking tips of antlion arrows.

2649.name: Colibri Fltchg.
desc: Colibri feathers that are fitted to the nock end of arrow shafts. They add to the directional stability of arrows in flight.

2650.name: Drk. Bolt Heads
desc: The striking tips of darkling bolts.

2651.name: Fsn. Bolt Heads
desc: The striking tips of fusion bolts.

2652.name: Gigas Helm
desc:
The huge headwear of a full-grown
Gigas. Incapable of being equipped by
any other race, the helmet is designed
as much for inducing fear in the enemy
as protecting the head of its wearer.

2653.name: Gigas Gauntlets
desc:
The massive gauntlets worn by armored
Gigas. Far too large or heavy to be
worn by people, the lack of skill in
craftsmanship is compensated for by
sheer enormity and ruggedness.

2654.name: Dark Ixion Horn
desc:
The twisted and contorted horn
wrested from the head of Dark Ixion.
It emits an alluring yet lackluster shine
of foreboding blackness.

2655.name: Dark Ixion Tail
desc:
The plush, full tail of Dark Ixion.
Despite the ominous aura of evil still
surrounding the fine hairs, their innate
beauty is undeniable.

2656.name: Luminian Thread
desc:
A radiant silken thread spun
of the finest luminian filaments.

2657.name: Flameshun Cloth
desc:
A fire-resistant cloth that has
been infused with liquid mythril
for enhanced flame retardancy.

2658.name: Silkworm Thread
desc:
An exquisite silk specimen produced
only by crawlers living in mountainous
regions. The especially fine quality is
attributed to high altitudes.

2659.name: Canvas Toile
desc:
A sturdy watch of cotton canvas
known predominantly for its use in the
construction of sails for ocean-faring
vessels.

2660.name: Pantin Wire
desc:
Durable, flexible wiring used in the
manipulation of marionettes and
various other puppets.

2661.name: Corduroy Cloth
desc:
A high-quality swatch of ridged velvet,
the cords of which run parallel to one
another in a vertical pattern.

2677.name: Bovine Brand Card
desc:
Officially issued by the M.H.M.U.
ranch publisher's press, this card
is used to keep track of how many
bovine brands you have acquired.

2702.name: Buckwheat Flour
desc:
A relatively dark flour made
by grinding the triangular seeds
of the buckwheat plant.

2703.name: Khrom. Leather
desc:
A piece of leather made from the
hide of a karakul. Khroma has been
incorporated into the tanning process,
resulting in the distinctive appearance
and properties.

2704.name: Oil-Soaked Clth.
desc:
A swatch of cloth soaked in oil
to enhance its resistance to water.

2705.name: Foulard
desc:
A light fabric made of silk which
gives off a beautiful, brilliant sheen.

2706.name: Blue Text. Dye
desc:
An all-natural, blue dye
used in the coloring of cloth.

2707.name: Green Text. Dye
desc:
An all-natural, green dye
used in the coloring of cloth.

2708.name: Yellow Txt. Dye
desc:
An all-natural, yellow dye
used in the coloring of cloth.

2709.name: White Text. Dye
desc:
An all-natural, white dye
used in the coloring of cloth.

2710.name: Soba Noodles
desc: Thin, round, elongated noodles made from buckwheat flour.

2711.name: Khroma Nugget
desc:
A small chunk of khroma.
Cursory examination reveals
that it is not without impurities.

2712.name: Red Textile Dye
desc:
An all-natural, red dye
used in the coloring of cloth.

2713.name: Dyer's Woad
desc:
A tall-growing grass which blooms
marvelous flowers of bright yellow.

2714.name: Filet Lace
desc:
An exquisite, meticulously stitched
piece of lace with a fishnet pattern.

2715.name: Gold Stud
desc:
A decorative gold button embossed
with a simple design.

2716.name: Brilliantine
desc:
A lustrous variety of tweed used as
lining in coats and various other types
of apparel.

2717.name: Electrum Stud
desc:
A decorative electrum button embossed
with a simple design.

2718.name: Etoile Tiara -1
desc:
An etoile tiara.
It is badly damaged
and can no longer be worn.

2719.name: Etoile Casaque -1

An etoile casaque.

2722.name: Etoile Toe Shoes -1

2723.name: Argute M.board -1
desc:
An argute mortarboard.

and can no longer be worn.

2724.name: Argute Gown -1

2726.name: Argute Pants -1

They are badly damaged
and can no longer be worn.

2727.name: Argute Loafers -1
desc:
A pair of argute loafers.
They are badly damaged
and can no longer be worn.

2728.name: Cernunnos Bulb
desc:
The bulb of the mobile plant known
as the Cernunnos. Though currently in
stasis, it can grow with the proper
nutrients.

2729.name: Hydrangea
desc:
An exotic flower that grows only in
the Far East, with leafy petals that
change hue from deep blue to a rich
reddish-violet.

2730.name: Mandragora Cap
desc:
A cork cap branded with
the face of a mandragora.
A Buffalo Bonanza Ranch exclusive.
Collect them all!

2731.name: Korrigan Cap
desc:
A cork cap branded with

A Buffalo Bonanza Ranch exclusive.
Collect them all!

2732.name: Lycopodium Cap

A cork cap branded with

2733.name: S. Smil. Leather
desc:
Enhanced by the power of anima,
the toughness of this piece of
smilodon leather is unworldly.

2734.name: MMM Member's Cd.
desc: A crumpled square of parchment haphazardly scrawled with a mishmash of unintelligible glyphs. Apparently used by the MMM Revitalization Team to monitor clients' stress levels.

2735.name: Dk. Ixion Ferrule
desc:
A ferrule fashioned from the
gnarled horn of Dark Ixion.
Long after being separated from its
master, it continues to pulse and
throb with an otherworldly energy.

2736.name: Kupon A-Lum
desc:
A prize redemption coupon from the Mog Bonanza event. Issued by the Mog House Management Union (MHMU).
Tradeable for spoils from notorious monsters in Lumoria.

2737.name: Silky Suede
desc:
The tough hide of a buffalo
has been meticulously napped to
create this silky-smooth fabric.

2738.name: Cassiopeia Card
desc:
A card created by the moogles for
the Starlight Celebration. When
opened, you can see twinkling stars.

2739.name: Perseus Card
desc:
A card created by the moogles for
the Starlight Celebration. When
opened, you can see twinkling stars.

2740.name: Seedspall Lux
desc:
A shard of the Seed Crystal recovered
from Jugner Forest. It blazes with the
blinding radiance of a white-hot sun.

2741.name: Seedspall Luna
desc:
A shard of the Seed Crystal recovered
from the Pashhow Marshlands.
It shines with the soft luminescence
of an autumn moon.

2742.name: Seedspall Astrum
desc:
A shard of the Seed Crystal recovered
from the Meriphataud Mountains.
It twinkles with the glittering splendor
of a sea of stars.

2743.name: Oxblood Orb
desc: An exquisite orb fashioned from the extremely rare variety of blood-red coral known as oxblood.

2744.name: Angel Skin Orb
desc: An exquisite orb fashioned from the extremely rare variety of pinkish coral known as angel skin.

2745.name: Kupon A-DBcd
desc:
A prize redemption coupon from the Mog Bonanza event. Issued by the Mog House Management Union (MHMU).
Tradeable for relic equipment from Dynamis - Beaucedine.

2746.name: Kupon A-DXar
desc:
A prize redemption coupon from the Mog Bonanza event. Issued by the Mog House Management Union (MHMU).
Tradeable for equipment from Dynamis - Xarcabard.

2747.name: Gargouille Horn
desc: A gargouille's horn, its edge as sharp as tempered steel.

2748.name: Garglle. Shank
desc: A shank of gargouille flesh, hardened by time into something resembling solid rock.

2749.name: Gargouille Eye
desc: The lustrous, crystalline eye of a gargouille.

2750.name: Amphiptere Hide
desc: The glossy, scaly hide of an amphiptere.

2751.name: Amph. Leather
desc: The rough hide of an amphiptere has been processed into a smooth and sturdy square of leather.

2752.name: Amph. Whisker
desc: The bristly, whip-like whisker of an amphiptere.

2753.name: Amphiptere Claw
desc: This razor-sharp claw is still specked with the blood of the amphiptere's unfortunate prey.

2754.name: Ruszor Fang
desc: The massive fang of a ruszor, sharp enough to slice through blocks of solid ice.

2755.name: Ruszor Hide
desc: The ruszor's hide is surprisingly soft and silky to the touch.

2756.name: Ruszor Leather
desc: This sturdy leather made from the hide of a ruszor is particularly resistant to frigid temperatures.

2757.name: Orc. Armor Plate
desc: A metal plate that appears to have fallen off of an Orcish warmachine.

2758.name: Quadav Backscale
desc: A bronze scale donned as added back protection by Quadav warriors.

2759.name: Yagudo Caulk
desc: A traditional adhesive and filling material invented by the Yagudo.

2760.name: Ratstail Explosive
desc: An explosive containing drab, mousy-gray gunpowder, manufactured in the traditional Goblin style.

2761.name: Feyweald Log
desc: A rough-cut log from a tree of the Feyweald, the pixie forest of legend.

2762.name: Feywld. Lumber
desc: Processed lumber from a tree of the Feyweald, the pixie forest of legend.

2763.name: Swamp Ore
desc: This slimy ore, found often in marshlands, contains the metal iron.

2764.name: Dweomer Steel
desc: Smelted by fey magic, this steel ingot is warm to the touch.

2765.name: Fool's Gold Ore
desc: This ore contains bronze, iron, and sulfur. Its luster pales in comparison to genuine gold.

2766.name: Oberon's Gold
desc: An ingot of the purest gold, smelted by the fey magic of Oberon, King of Faeries.

2767.name: Ob. Gold Sheet
desc: A gleaming sheet of the purest gold, smelted by the fey magic of Oberon, King of Faeries.

2768.name: Revertant: Sing.
desc: An acrid-smelling concoction used by synergists to repair defects in various materials. Small in quantity, it appears to be of a very high concentration.

2769.name: Buggane Horn
desc: The pitch-black horn of a buggane, a fearsome ogre summoned by pixies to exact revenge on invaders who threatened their forest home. It glows with an eerie energy.

2770.name: White Butterfly
desc: A magnificent white butterfly with gossamer wings that glisten in the sunlight.

2771.name: Bell Cricket
desc: A colorful species of jumping bug known for its peaceful chirping song.

2772.name: Glowfly
desc: A small, jet-black insect of the beetle family that emits an ethereal yellowish glow from its abdomen.

2773.name: Fine Parchment
desc: Scribes the world over swear by this fine quality sheepskin parchment for the hours of smudge-free writing pleasure it offers.

2774.name: Enchanted Ink
desc: Literally fill your words with magic with this rare variety of enchanted ink.

2775.name: Padded Box
desc: An empty box lined with shock-absorbent material, designed for the transportation of fragile objects. Includes wrapping paper.

2776.name: Pumice Stone
desc: This pumice stone is used to rub away the layer of sheen from animal hide.

2777.name: Magicked Blood
desc: The dark magic infused within this portion of blood causes it to swish about fitfully within its vial.

2778.name: Inferior Cocoon
desc: A low-grade cocoon of unknown origin, unsuitable for commercial use.

2779.name: Enfeeb. Kit: Poison
desc: The enfeeblement kit requested by Doctor Shantotto.

2780.name: Enfeeb. Kit: Blind
desc: The enfeeblement kit requested by Doctor Shantotto.

2781.name: Enfeeb. Kit: Sleep
desc: The enfeeblement kit requested by Doctor Shantotto.

2782.name: Enfeeb. Kit: Silence
desc: The enfeeblement kit requested by Doctor Shantotto.

2783.name: Evolith
desc: An ordinary stone with no distinguishing features evident to the naked eye.

2784.name: Fire Fewell

2785.name: Ice Fewell
desc: A synergy staple, this substance yields potent elemental power when burned.

2790.name: Light Fewell

2791.name: Dark Fewell
desc: A synergy staple, this substance yields potent elemental power when burned.

2792.name: Catalytic Oil
desc: Developed by the Bastokan Alchemists' Guild, this oil can be added to various substances to facilitate combustion.

2793.name: Flamestone
desc: A brilliant red stone that harbors the elemental power of fire.

2794.name: Froststone
desc: A deep blue stone that harbors the elemental power of ice.

2795.name: Galestone
desc: A vivid green stone that harbors the elemental power of wind.

2796.name: Tremorstone
desc: A rich brown stone that harbors the elemental power of earth.

2797.name: Stormstone
desc: A bright violet stone that harbors the elemental power of lightning.

2798.name: Tidestone
desc: A translucent stone that harbors the elemental power of water.

2799.name: Astral Matter
desc: This otherworldly substance seems to warp any light that passes through it.

2800.name: Revertant
desc: An acrid-smelling concoction used by synergists to repair defects in various materials.

2801.name: Kupon AW-Pan
desc:
A prize redemption coupon from the Mog Bonanza event. Issued by the Mog House Management Union (MHMU).

2804.name: Mordant 30

2808.name: Ebon Pigment

2809.name: Furia Pigment
desc: A powerful colorant used by synergists to infuse materials with fiery red hues.

2810.name: Ebur Pigment
desc: A powerful colorant used by synergists to infuse materials with the pure white of ivory.

2811.name: Aptant: Primus
desc: A burnished metallic token bearing an ancient glyph for "source."

2812.name: Aptant: Aecus
desc: A burnished metallic token bearing an ancient glyph for "equality."

2813.name: Aptant: Durus
desc: A burnished metallic token bearing an ancient glyph for "durable."

2814.name: Aptant: Bellum

2815.name: Aptant: Arkhe
